title: Chamberlain myQ Outdoor Battery 2K Camera (3-Pack)

comparisons.notes: Same 3-pack of 2K battery cameras (myQ direct SKU MYQ-MM9VXXW; retail model MYQ-C393XXW, same contents): 130 degree lens, color night vision, spotlight, 3 cameras, mounts and charging cables. Shown at $249.99 with an active Add to Cart button.

writeup: Woot has a new 3-pack of Chamberlain myQ Outdoor Battery 2K cameras for $54.99, about $18 per camera. myQ's own store charges $249.99 for the same 3-pack, so this is 78% less. The cameras are wire-free with a 130 degree lens, color night vision and a motion spotlight. Woot showed only 1 left, limit 2 per customer.
